holdout_note: Five of six frozen candidates were profitable under the same fixed definitions in 2026; the NORMAL-VIX call backspread lost ₹86,270.78 net and ₹86,855.55 under +50% cost stress.
conclusion: No VIX-conditioned ready-made strategy is promoted. LOW-VIX bear call/bear put spreads are the strongest empirical candidates, but the broader strategy×regime family produced no Holm-adjusted statistical survivor. Canonical Phase-20/42 strategy remains unchanged.
